E6.summary: Development selection and evaluation reporting share frame Dice followed by patient class-macro aggregation.
E6.empty_class_policy: Only frames with reference presence contribute to a class Dice; patient FG Dice averages supported class means.
E6.regression: Two unequal-support frames produce the exact shared patient RV Dice 0.75; pooled-count Dice would be approximately 0.5238. Evaluation reporting matches the shared selector aggregator.

F1.summary: Physiology-weighted KD validates all U patient weights after P cache construction and again on J cache reload before optimizer construction.
F1.allzero_behavior: Real execution fails closed before the first J optimizer update; the regression asserts unchanged student weights and zero J updates.
F1.support_semantics: The guard examines patient w_pat only. Positive patient support with a zero-weight individual U cell branch remains allowed; existing branch/global KD collapse rules still apply.
bypasses: V0 and V1-U have no physiology-weighted KD
F1.synthetic_override: Only the existing explicit synthetic smoke override may continue past an all-zero support gate. The gate remains recorded as failed with override_used=true and synthetic-only scope. Real configs cannot use the bypass.
